lines: Down the east side, four hops, and you are back here before the kettle boils.
That is what it is for. Nobody should have to earn the same gantry twice.
Three gantries up. A tile wide each, no rail, and every one of them is watched.
Four cornices down the east side when you are done, and they only go one way.
The two decks off to the west go nowhere. There is a box on each and somebody sitting by it.
